senses.zh_definition: 奥尔布赖特：外语姓氏，也可构成机构等专名；具体所指须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A surname, also occurring in institutional and other proper names; its referent depends on context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga asing yang juga boleh menjadi sebahagian daripada nama khas institusi atau entiti lain; rujukannya bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，不应标为已获官方认可的马来语普通词。正文须写作 Albright。输入未提供具体人物或实体，不能直接等同于某位名人。以下搭配展示称谓和姓名的组合，不代表已验证的高频词组。姓氏依据：[Dictionary of American Family Names，经 Ancestry 提供](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/Albright?geo-lang=en)。

etymology.historical_story: Albright illustrates how surnames travel between languages. The Dictionary of American Family Names identifies an Americanized German source, Albrecht, and an English source connected with the medieval personal name Albriht. These are alternative family histories, so the spelling alone cannot establish a particular person's ancestry. [Source: Dictionary of American Family Names via Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/Albright?geo-lang=en).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Albright 当作姓名牌整体记住：后半段读音近英语 bright，但姓名不能据此翻译成“明亮”。
